REFUGE.defaultHint: Added automatically when a new Refuge is created.
REFUGE.repeatable: Can Be Purchased More Than Once
REFUGE.anchorHint: Use in a Close area while the chosen Entity has 0 Resolve. Test the chosen stat against Wyrd Defence. Failure places 3 Threat; success consumes the Anchor and lowers all Defences and maximum Resolve by 1 (2 on a superior or critical success). A standard success also places 1 Threat.
REFUGE.anchorPayment: Pay Bone or Sacrifice an Unused Relic
REFUGE.anchorUnavailable: Use this Anchor in combat, from a Close area, against its chosen Entity at 0 Resolve. The bearer must not be Dying or dead, and the Entity must not already be Anchored.
REFUGE.anchorSuccess: {name} is Anchored: all Defences and maximum Resolve reduced by {penalty}. The Anchor is consumed. No Heart is awarded when this Entity is defeated.
REFUGE.researchAnyStatHint: The researcher must confirm that the Gaol is occupied for this attempt.
REFUGE.researchBone: Extra Bone to Spend (-3 TN Each)
REFUGE.researchEncountered: Interacted with Related Thralls or Hazards (-3 TN)
REFUGE.researchOccupiedGaol: Interrogate a Thrall in an Occupied Gaol
REFUGE.researchEdge: Edge on Success (Improved on Superior Success)
REFUGE.researchExtraEdge: Additional Improved Edge on Critical Success
REFUGE.researchAssistantUnavailable: An assisting Hunter has left, died or spent their last Refuge Action.
REFUGE.researchHardTest: Research: Hard Test (Closing Rolls Normally Without Focus)
REFUGE.selectionMissing: A selected item or Entity no longer exists.
REFUGE.openHeartHint: Until this Hollow is cleansed or you die, count as two Hunters for Entity Enhancements. Defeated Entities award 2 additional Bone.
REFUGE.closeHeartHint: Until this Hollow is cleansed or you die, do not count towards the number of Hunters for Entity Enhancements.
REFUGE.syphonHint: Destroy this captive Entity. Each Hunter currently in the Refuge gains a permanent +2 to a chosen stat and tests Corruption; rolling over grants 1 Corruption and an Echo.
REFUGE.syphonResult: Essence Syphon: +2 {stat}. Corruption test against {corruption}; rolling over grants 1 Corruption and an Echo.
REFUGE.renewMarks: Marks Required for a Permanent Stat Increase
REFUGE.healthBonus: Bonus Maximum Health for All Hunters
REFUGE.healthBonusHint: These bonuses cannot raise maximum Resolve or Wounds above 10.
REFUGE.activeHollowRequired: Choose an active Hollow before using Renew or Revel.
REFUGE.renewAlreadyUsed: This Hunter has already used Renew in this Hollow.
REFUGE.renewHint: Gain one mark and +1 to the chosen stat until death or the end of this Hollow. At the required number of marks, the increase becomes permanent instead; roll a D20, and if it exceeds your Corruption, gain 1 Corruption and generate an Echo.
REFUGE.renewTemporary: {name} gains +1 {stat} until death or the end of this Hollow.
REFUGE.renewPermanent: {name} permanently gains +1 {stat} and clears its Renew marks.
REFUGE.revelHint: Choose {count} Echoes to suppress. All unsuppressed Boons must be selected before any Banes.
REFUGE.suppressBoonsFirst: Suppress all remaining Boons before selecting a Bane.
REFUGE.revelWithoutEchoes: No unsuppressed Echoes remain. Spend the Refuge action and roll to reduce Corruption?
REFUGE.revelSuppressed: Echoes suppressed until the end of this Hollow: {names}.
REFUGE.extraRelicSlot: Relic or Anchor Uses a Separate Equipment Slot
REFUGE.sharedBattleSlot: A Relic or Anchor shares the Battle Equipment slot. Remove the other item first, or install an upgrade granting a separate slot.
REFUGE.hardTestOnInstall: Player Characters Test Hard on Installation
REFUGE.hardTestOnInstallHint: Each player's assigned Hunter tests Hard, including offline players; a failed test adds 1 Corruption. Outstanding tests appear on the Refuge sheet.
REFUGE.installationTestsHint: Test Hard for each listed upgrade. A failed test adds 1 Corruption.
REFUGE.reforge: Reforge a Weapon or Change Its Form
REFUGE.nothingToReplace: There are no eligible items to replace.
REFUGE.noReplacement: No available Tier {tier} replacement for {name}. Unlock the tier or add the required ability templates before continuing.
REFUGE.requiresTwoWeapons: Reshaping requires a Hunter with two Weapons.
REFUGE.statPermutation: Use each existing stat value once. Choose a different source stat for each field.
REFUGE.confirmWeaponChanges: Apply these changes and pay the Refuge action cost?
REFUGE.missingSelectedItem: A selected item is no longer available. Choose the Refuge action again.
REFUGE.temporaryHealthGained: {name} gains {resolve} temporary Resolve and {wounds} temporary Wounds.
REFUGE.recoverOnEntryHint: Each visiting Hunter may fully recover once without spending a Refuge action.
REFUGE.pending: Available from the next Hunter's entry into the Refuge.
REFUGE.mustRecover: This Hunter must recover from death before taking another Refuge action.
REFUGE.insufficientResources: Not enough Bone or Hearts in the Refuge.
REFUGE.selectVisitor: Choose a Hunter in the Refuge
REFUGE.noVisitors: No Hunters are currently in the Refuge.
REFUGE.hunterNotInRefuge: This Hunter must enter the Refuge before using its actions.
REFUGE.noActionsRemaining: This Hunter does not have enough Refuge actions remaining this visit.
REFUGE.noAvailableHunters: None of your Hunters in the Refuge can take this action.
REFUGE.confirmRemoval: Remove {name}? Its purchase cost will not be refunded.
REFUGE.noUpgrades: No upgrades installed. Buy an upgrade or drag one onto this sheet.

SCRIPT.title: Mechanic Script
SCRIPT.gmOnly: Only a GM can edit mechanic scripts.
SCRIPT.gmCreateOnly: Ask a GM to create or import items containing mechanic scripts.
SCRIPT.cannotEdit: This script cannot be edited on the selected item.
SCRIPT.disabledWarning: Custom scripts are disabled. Enable Allow Custom Mechanic Scripts in the system settings first. Scripts run on connected clients; enable them only for trusted content.
SCRIPT.disabled: Custom scripts are disabled in system settings
SCRIPT.trustedHint: Runs even when Allow Custom Scripts is disabled. Editing the code or execution settings clears this checkbox.
SCRIPT.label: Label
SCRIPT.labelPlaceholder: Shown on buttons and in chat
SCRIPT.multipleHint: Return named handlers with hook and run(H, actor, ctx); configuration-only modifiers need no run. actor is the affected Hunter; ctx.carrier owns the ability.
SCRIPT.reactionHint: For asynchronous hooks, use promptOnPlayer(H, actor, ctx) for the owner's choice and optional applyOnGM(H, actor, ctx, choice) for its effect. Return a JSON-serializable choice, or null/false to skip without spending the limit.
SCRIPT.invalidDefinitions: Return an object of named handlers.
SCRIPT.ambiguousEvent: Handler "{id}" must use either event or eventType, not both.
SCRIPT.syncHint: Synchronous hook: no await; only the synchronous helpers below are available.
SCRIPT.syncPromise: A synchronous hook cannot return a Promise.

apiNotes.resource: Resource changes are routed through the GM when needed. focusCount only reads state.
apiNotes.condition: set routes changes through the GM when needed. has only reads state.
apiNotes.threat: Threat changes are routed through the GM. remove and shift may prompt for zones.
apiNotes.ask: Prompts appear on the client running the script.
apiNotes.effects: Permissions and prompts depend on the chosen effects.
apiNotes.chat: Uses the executing user's permission to create chat messages. Actor ownership is not required.

settings.name: Allow Custom Mechanic Scripts
settings.hint: Weapons and Weapon Abilities may carry GM-written JavaScript. These scripts run on connected clients, including players. Enable only for trusted content.

SCRIPT.error: Script "{key}" {phase}: {message}. Further repeats are logged in the console.
